text:
tom: Heads-up: links to /guides/sdk#rate-limits are 404ing from the quickstart. The anchor exists on the page but the fragment doesn't match. Reported by a customer.

anya: can you paste the heading from the docs page? i bet it's an invisible char or smart quote from copy/paste.

tom: here's the markdown chunk: 
```md
## Rate limits — best practices
We recommend...
```

rob: that dash is an em-dash (U+2014). our slugifier produces `rate-limits-	6best-practices` (with a weird codepoint) while the link in quickstart used a normal hyphen `rate-limits-best-practices`. browser mismatch -> lands at top of page not section.

anya: annoying. quick fixes: 1) change heading to `## Rate limits (best practices)` or 2) add explicit id `{#rate-limits-best-practices}`.

tom: i'll open a tiny PR switching heading to parens + explicit id. also adding a normalization step to linkcheck to detect non-ascii punctuation in generated slugs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3589

linkwatch-bot: New PR #3589: normalise heading punctuation + linkcheck slug-sanity. Requested reviewers: @anya.

ci-bot: Running `yarn docs:linkcheck` on PR #3589. Added slug sanity grep: `mkdocs build --site-dir .site && cat .site/*.html | grep -oP 'id="[^"]+"' | sed 's/id="//;s/"//' | python3 -c "import sys,unicodedata;print('\n'.join([s for s in sys.stdin.read().splitlines() if any(ord(c)>127 for c in s)]))"`

ci-bot: Linkcheck finished: found 1 non-ascii slug in docs/guides/sdk.md -> flagged.

rob: LGTM, merged with commit b7c1a2d. Heading now `## Rate limits (best practices) {#rate-limits-best-practices}` and linkcheck step kept.

tom: nice, customer verified the quickstart link works now. filing a follow-up to sweep repo for headings containing em/en dashes or smart quotes.

anya: adding note to CONTRIBUTING.md: "Use ASCII hyphen-minus for headings or add explicit heading id to avoid fragment mismatches."

ci-bot: All green on main.
